senses.gloss:
धट धट, अस्, m. (probably a Prākṛt form
of धर्तृ, derived from the nom. sing. धर्ता and
rt. धृ, like भट्, भाट, भाटक, भाटि fr. rt.
भृ; cf. तुला-धट and तुलया धृ under तुला),
a balance, the scale of a balance, a pair of scales;
the sign of the zodiac Libra; ordeal by the balance;
(ई), f. old cloth or raiment; a piece of cloth worn
over the privities.
—धटी-दान, अम्, n. giving old
cloth to a woman after impregnation.

धटक धटक, अस्, m. a kind of weight
equal to 14 Vallas or 42 Raktikās.

धटिन् धटिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Śiva,
(perhaps a wrong reading for घटिन्; cf. घण्ट,
घण्टिन्, घटिघट); (इनी), f. a cotton cloth or
string fastened round the loins; [cf. धटी under
धट.]

धटोत्कच धटोत्कच, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(probably for घटोत्कच.)

धाटी धाटी, f. assault, assaulting or con-
fronting an enemy.
